# Load Libraries

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(mapgl)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(tidyverse)

```

# First Version

```{r}
county_data <- st_read(here("data/county_data.gpkg"))
languages <- sort(unique(county_data$language))

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Language Speakers in the United States by County"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("language", "Select a language:", choices = languages, selected = "Spanish")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      mapboxglOutput("county_map", height = "800px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$county_map <- renderMapboxgl({
    filtered_data <- county_data %>% filter(language == input$language)

    continuous_scale <- interpolate_palette(
      data = filtered_data,
      column = "percent_speakers",
      method = "quantile",
      n = 5,
      palette = viridis
    )

    mapboxgl(bounds = filtered_data, options = NULL) |>
      add_fill_layer(
        id = "counties",
        source = filtered_data,
        fill_color = continuous_scale$expression,
        fill_opacity = 0.8
        )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

# Added Legend

```{r}
county_data <- st_read(here("data/county_data.gpkg"))
languages <- sort(unique(county_data$language))

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Language Speakers in the United States by County"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("language", "Select a language:", choices = languages, selected = "Spanish")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      # Wrap map output in relative container for legend positioning
      div(style = "position: relative;",
          mapboxglOutput("county_map", height = "800px"),

          # Legend box in top-left
          div(
            style = "
              position: absolute;
              top: 30px;
              left: 30px;
              width: 220px;
              background: white;
              padding: 10px;
              border-radius: 5px;
              box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
              font-size: 12px;
              z-index: 1000;
              user-select: none;
            ",
            tags$b("Percent Speakers"),
            div(
              style = "height: 20px; width: 100%; 
                       background: linear-gradient(to right,
                       #440154, #482878, #3E4989, #31688E, #26828E, 
                       #1F9E89, #35B779, #6DCD59, #B4DD2C, #FDE725);
                       margin-top: 5px;"
            ),
            div(
              style = "display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 2px;",
              tags$span("0"),
              tags$span("0.5"),
              tags$span("1"),
              tags$span("2"),
              tags$span("5"),
              tags$span("10"),
              tags$span("20"),
              tags$span("50")
            )
          )
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$county_map <- renderMapboxgl({
    filtered_data <- county_data %>% filter(language == input$language)

    continuous_scale <- interpolate_palette(
      data = filtered_data,
      column = "percent_speakers",
      method = "quantile",
      n = 5,
      palette = viridis
    )

    mapboxgl(bounds = filtered_data, options = NULL) |>
      add_fill_layer(
        id = "counties",
        source = filtered_data,
        fill_color = continuous_scale$expression,
        fill_opacity = 0.8
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
